title: 交通工具
a:
I'd like to describe a car that I'd really like to own, which is a Mini Cooper.

A friend of mine bought a Mini Cooper last month. It cost her around 250,000 yuan. But I would say it looks like a 500,000 yuan car.（在真实的英文谈话里像 I would say… 这类的小短语特别多，其实并不是“非说不可”，但说了就更像是人与人之间的交谈，而不是机器与机器之间的互殴）

The car looks very cute, like a chubby baby because it looks compact and solid. Actually, the inside is quite spacious. The front seats feel very comfortable, and there's plenty of headroom. The back seats are a bit small, but that won't be a big issue for me.

The car is well-equipped. I particularly like the backup camera because it makes parking easier and safer. The speakers also sound very impressive.

Unlike Beetles, Mini has a powerful engine. It's fuel-efficient as well.

I'd like to own a Mini because it's fun and comfortable to drive, and it's good value for money.
vocab: won't be a big issue for me
它的性价比很高（这句话在英国人说物品的性价比很高时极为常用）
good gas mileage / good fuel economy
底盘（真正的车迷都明白 engine 和 chassis 才是最重要的，车的外观真心不值多少钱）
车的品牌（这时它作名词）
奔驰（注意：在英国，人们总是用 Mercedes 来简称“奔驰”，一些朋友用 Benz 来简称“奔驰”其实是不地道的英文）
雪佛兰（生活里也经常简称为 Chevy）

title: 双语感悟：自行车
cue: Describe an important invention（before the age of computers）.
a:
在计算机之前的发明，bicycle 是比较好说的一种了：

It was invented in the late 19th century by some Frenchmen.

It became popular soon after it was invented, because it didn't cost much and it was easy to ride.

Also, cycling（骑自行车）was faster and more efficient（更快也更高效的）than walking.（国内同学爱用 biking 说“骑自行车”，但是 native speakers 更常用 cycling）

Today, millions of people ride their bikes regularly（经常骑自行车）.

Some people cycle to work or school.（骑自行车上班或者上学）. Others ride their bikes just for fun.（就是为了乐趣骑自行车）

Cycling is also a good form of exercise.（也是很好的锻炼方式）

It improves balance and coordination.（增强平衡与协调能力）

It can boost endurance（提高耐力）and burn calories（消耗热量，“燃烧卡路里”）as well.

不妨再了解一下 bicycle 的各个部分（parts）：

铃铛是 bell，不过好像我在北京骑过的几辆车铃铛都不响（The bell didn't work.）。车把叫 handlebars，车闸叫 brakes，横梁是 crossbar，车座是 saddle，脚踏板是 pedals，链条叫 chain，轮子当然就是 tyres（英式）/ tires（美式）了。

有些比较贵的自行车还有“变速器”，在国外这个部分叫作 shifter。

如果自行车很新就说 It's brand-new. 已经比较旧了请说 It's a bit worn-out. 如果已经很久没骑过了，可以说 It is gathering dust now（在“积累灰尘”）.

在北京如果 cycling 时还戴头盔，肯定会被认为是小题大做（make a fuss about nothing）。但是在英国，骑自行车时戴头盔（wear a helmet while riding a bike）却极为常见，而且有很多英国人认为骑自行车戴头盔是有责任感的体现（It shows that you are a responsible and reliable person.）。您也完全可以说一句 I always wear a helmet while riding my bike. 然后等着看考官的反应。

在中国工作的雅思考官们当中环保主义者（environmentalists）的比例很高，所以还可以介绍自行车对环保的好处，比如：Bicycles don't need fuel（不需要燃料），so they can help to reduce carbon emissions（减少碳排放）. 如果您从周一到周五每天都骑自行车上下班，或者上学、放学都骑自行车，也别忘了说一句 I cycle to work（or school）every weekday because it's more eco-friendly（环保的）than driving.

title: 双语感悟：坏了的物品
cue: Describe something in your home which was broken or didn't work.
a:
Pat 发现有很多同学误以为这道题必须要描述一件“被打碎的东西”。事实上，broken 在地道英文里经常用来指家用电器（home appliance）或者电子产品（electronic product）坏掉了。

比如，native speakers 经常说这样的句子：My iPad was broken but luckily, it was covered by Apple's warranty（保修）.

清楚了 broken 的真实含义，您就明白了说这道题的选择其实挺多的，说一个“坏了”的电子产品更容易一些，比如：

I'd like to describe my laptop.

It had been working well for two years. But last week, it went out of order（不能正常运行）all of a sudden（突然地）after I downloaded a file（下载文件）which was attached to an email（作为一份电子邮件的附件）. The file looked safe. However, after I opened it, I ended up with a virus（病毒）in the laptop. The virus was so powerful that the operating system of the laptop crashed（操作系统崩溃了）right away and it destroyed the hard drive（破坏了硬盘）too. The screen also went back（黑屏）while the laptop was still running. So I had to turn off the laptop, only to find out that it wouldn't even boot up（电脑启动）anymore.

I got really worried that I wouldn't be able to get the files back from the hard drive. And my laptop was not covered by warranty（不在保修内）anymore. So I took the laptop to a local computer store immediately. Their employees are still working on it. All I can do now is to wait patiently and hope for the best. Hopefully, they can fix the problems for me and I'll be able to get all the files back from the hard drive.

而且，把这个答案的结尾稍微改一下还可以同时准备好 Describe a time when you made a mistake.（犯错的经历）这道难题，比如改为这样结尾：

I made a serious mistake because I didn't try to make sure the file was safe before downloading it. On the other hand, I learnt an important lesson from this mistake. Now I know I must be really careful when I download things from the Internet.

title: 超短线：收到的一封信
cue: Describe a letter that you received.
a:
比较容易描述的信的种类有 a thank-you letter（比如你帮助了一位老年人或者小朋友，家属向你来信致谢，或者你在社区做志愿者服务 did volunteer work 而收到的感谢信）和 an apology letter（道歉信，比如你的一个朋友曾经没有告诉你关于某件事情的真实情况，后来写信向你道歉）.

也可以说 an admission letter（录取信，比如你收到过的学校录取通知），a job offer letter（提供工作职位的信），an invitation letter（邀请信，比如你最好的朋友准备结婚，邀请你参加婚礼 invited me to the wedding）等。

“惊喜”的地道英文是 a nice surprise，如果一封信让你一整天都很高兴，native speakers 会说 The letter really made my day.

而且，这道题的后面几个 ideas 也可以帮助你快速准备好 Describe a piece of good news that you read recently.（近期读到的好消息）这个话题。
